profile.Name: Big Gray
profile.Personality: An honorable swamp boss by gang standards, armed with a ninja blade and a straw hat.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Grayflayers from Grayflayer Village, and the Hounds grumble that he is getting out of hand. A swamper's letter says some of his gang resent him for refusing to avenge a slain clan member.
profile.SpeechQuirks: No speech of his is recorded.
